findings.title: Call to undefined isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()
findings.body: UsernameForm.authenticate calls isConditionalPasskeysEnabled() with no arguments, but the changed UsernamePasswordForm only defines isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel). No no-arg method is present in UsernameForm, UsernamePasswordForm, or AbstractUsernameFormAuthenticator, so this change will not compile. If the intent is to check the current user, call isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(context.getUser()); otherwise add the missing no-arg helper.

findings.title: Conditional passkeys are no longer initialized for user-less first login
findings.body: isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel) returns false when user is null, and it is used in authenticate (line 115) and challenge (line 137) to decide whether to call webauthnAuth.fillContextForm. The previous code initialized conditional passkey data when no user was known, which is the normal first-login / ID-less passkey scenario. After this change, the initial login page and error states where the user has been cleared will not receive the WebAuthn challenge/attributes, so passkey autofill/passwordless passkey login is unavailable. This regresses first-login passkey behavior and contradicts the tests asserting that //form[@id='webauth'] is present on the initial login page.
